description: Comprehensive audit of all candidate decision variables, hard constraints, and multi-objective criteria against the verified M4/M5 canonical database state (47 records, 15 entities, 34 barrier observations, 11 packaging materials).

parameters.name: Discrete Packaging Material Identity
parameters.current_coverage: 11 distinct packaging materials (10 experimental/commercial, 1 QSAR model predicted).
verified_sources: Commercial Polymer Manufacturer TDS (Kuraray, NatureWorks, DuPont, Amcor)
parameters.mathematical_usage: Primary discrete categorical decision variable x_mat in {1, ..., 11}.
parameters.rationale: Directly queryable in M5 database; represents real commercial films and resins.

parameters.name: Material Structure Morphology
parameters.current_coverage: 11 materials classified as MONOLAYER (8) or MULTILAYER (3).
parameters.mathematical_usage: Structural constraint and discrete design parameter.
parameters.rationale: Explicitly represented in M5 canonical schema as StructureType enum.

parameters.name: Multilayer Polymer Sequence
parameters.current_coverage: Populated for all multilayer materials (e.g., ['PP', 'EVOH', 'PP'], ['PET', 'Alu', 'PE']).
parameters.mathematical_usage: Permutation constraint for multilayer laminate configurations.
parameters.rationale: Preserved in M5 PackagingMaterial.layer_sequence JSONB column.

parameters.name: Measured Film Gauge / Thickness
parameters.current_coverage: 100% of material observations have explicit thickness. Global observed values: 12, 15, 25, 30, 40, 50, 70 um. Each material currently has a single evidenced thickness; material-specific candidate eligibility requires evidence-level mapping.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Discrete thickness selection in primary catalog search mode.
parameters.rationale: Directly populated in MaterialBarrierObservation.thickness_value.

parameters.name: Continuous Film Gauge Scaling
parameters.current_coverage: Supported only for isotropic monolayers via P/t scaling; NOT supported for complex coextruded multilayers.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Continuous bounded variable t in [t_min, t_max] for exploratory optimization.
parameters.rationale: M5 project governance restricts unverified continuous normalization on multilayers. Monolayers can scale if tagged.

parameters.name: Package Surface Area
parameters.current_coverage: Specified in user request or defaulted to 0.06 m2 (Phase 4/5 contract).
parameters.mathematical_usage: Converts per-package transmission demands to normalized areal flux: TR_areal = TR_pkg / A_pkg.
parameters.rationale: Fully integrated in Phase 4 and Phase 5 request schemas.

parameters.name: Headspace Gas Volume
parameters.current_coverage: Specified in user request or defaulted via package volume / fill ratio.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Transient headspace gas mass balance for MAP flush design.
parameters.rationale: Supported in Phase 4 GasExchangeRequirement.

parameters.name: Active O2 Scavenger Sachet / Layer Capacity
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Would add a non-permeation gas sink term to headspace mass balance.
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: No empirical scavenger absorption kinetics or commercial sachet ratings exist in current verified evidence.

parameters.name: Active Desiccant Sachet Capacity
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Would add a moisture absorption buffer term to water vapor balance.
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: No verified silica gel or molecular sieve adsorption isotherms in database.

parameters.name: Antimicrobial Active Coating Release Rate
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Would modify microbial specific growth rate mu_max via chemical hurdle.
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: No verified active antimicrobial release data in database.

parameters.name: Water Vapor Transmission Rate Upper Bound
parameters.current_coverage: 100% computable from Phase 4 sorption balance; evaluated across all M5 materials.
verified_sources: ASTM F1249 / ASTM E96 in M5 database
parameters.mathematical_usage: WVTR_mat <= WVTR_allowable.
parameters.rationale: Primary food safety / moisture preservation gate.

parameters.name: Oxygen Transmission Rate Feasibility Window
parameters.current_coverage: 100% computable from Phase 4 respiration balance; evaluated across all M5 materials.
parameters.mathematical_usage: OTR_min <= OTR_mat <= OTR_max (respiring) or OTR_mat <= OTR_max (non-respiring).
parameters.rationale: Prevents anaerobic fermentation or oxidative rancidity.

parameters.name: Carbon Dioxide Transmission Rate Target / Tolerance
parameters.current_coverage: Present in 12 M5 barrier observations (CIRAD, Manufacturer TDS).
parameters.mathematical_usage: CO2TR_mat >= CO2TR_min_injury_prevention.
parameters.rationale: Protects produce from CO2 injury while maintaining microbial inhibition.

parameters.name: Environmental Test Condition Compatibility
parameters.current_coverage: 100% of barrier observations record test temperature; 100% record test RH.
parameters.mathematical_usage: ConditionMatch in {EXACT, SUPPORTED}; INCOMPATIBLE or UNKNOWN excludes candidate from P*.
parameters.rationale: Strictly enforces UNKNOWN != FEASIBLE.

parameters.name: Total Material Thickness Minimization
parameters.current_coverage: Populated for all 34 barrier observations in M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Minimize f_1(x) = t_total.
parameters.rationale: Represents source reduction and packaging tare weight minimization.

parameters.name: Moisture Barrier Safety Margin
parameters.current_coverage: Computable for all candidates passing WVTR hard constraint.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Maximize f_2(x) = (WVTR_allowable - WVTR_mat) / WVTR_allowable.
parameters.rationale: Quantifies barrier buffer against ambient humidity spikes.

parameters.name: Gas Transmission Target Alignment
parameters.current_coverage: Computable for all candidates with OTR and CO2TR data.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Minimize f_3(x) = |OTR_mat - OTR_target| / OTR_target + 0.5 * |beta_mat - beta_ideal| / beta_ideal.
parameters.rationale: Prevents produce senescence while avoiding fermentation.

parameters.name: Shelf-Life Extension Margin
parameters.current_coverage: Computable from limiting deterioration kinetics in Phase 4.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Maximize f_4(x) = (t_achievable - t_target) / t_target.
parameters.rationale: Direct commercial value metric indicating retail shelf life headroom.

parameters.name: Packaging Material Economic Cost
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Minimize f_cost(x) = Cost_film * Area + Cost_conversion.
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: No verified resin pricing or commercial conversion cost streams currently ingested. Fabrication strictly prohibited.

parameters.name: Life Cycle Global Warming Potential (GWP)
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Minimize f_GWP(x) = sum(m_l * GWP_l).
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: No cradle-to-gate Life Cycle Inventory (LCI) emission factors currently ingested. Fabrication strictly prohibited.

parameters.name: Mechanical Recyclability & Resin Identification
parameters.current_coverage: Present in manufacturer TDS and CIRAD datasets (e.g. recycling_code: 'LDPE-04', recyclable: true).
parameters.mathematical_usage: Categorical boolean filter: require_recyclable == True or allow_monomaterial_only.
parameters.rationale: Qualitative sustainability tags exist, but lack continuous circularity scoring. Operates as discrete filter, not continuous Pareto objective.

parameters.name: Bio-Based Polymer Content
parameters.current_coverage: Explicitly recorded for Ingeo PLA (100% bio-based) and PolyID PLA/PHA.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Filter condition: bio_based == True or bio_content >= min_threshold.
parameters.rationale: Documented on biopolymers; operates as categorical constraint.

parameters.name: Heat Sealing Initiation & Window
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Sealing compatibility constraint for form-fill-seal machinery.
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: Sealing initiation temperature (SIT) and hot tack strength not currently in M5 schema.

parameters.name: Mechanical Puncture & Tensile Strength
parameters.current_coverage: 0 records in M4/M5 database.
parameters.mathematical_usage: Mechanical resistance constraint for heavy produce or puncture-prone stems.
parameters.rationale: DATA GAP: Mechanical tensile properties (ASTM D882) not yet ingested into M5 database.
